_note: Calibration skeleton — stage_unit and minor_unit_m fields require manual transcription from TIFF side scales. See DATASET_DOCUMENTATION.md §6.4.

1830s-50s.note: Side scale occasionally visible at left edge. Stage unit may be Bavarian feet (1 Fuss ≈ 0.2919 m) or decimal cm. Transcribe from scan 210012 (1835) header.

1862-63.note: Denser printing than 1830s form. Scan IDs 210042-210043.

fine-grid.note: CRITICAL: stage rulings are 16 px not 24. Each 16 px = 1 minor unit. Stage unit may differ from 1830s form. Scan IDs 210053, 210054, 210058, 210059.

unclassified.note: Form not yet classified. Inspect TIFF headers for 210044, 210045, 210064, 210071, 210072, 210074. Grid spacing estimated from manifest audit.

station_epochs.datum_note: Pre-1845 Ulm gauge. Relationship to Neu-Ulm gauge zero unestablished. Must be resolved from archival records before combining epochs.
Post-1845 Neu-Ulm gauge. Modern Neu-Ulm gauge data available from BfG/WSV for comparison — requires datum alignment.

transcription_procedure.step_1: Open full-resolution TIFF (not the 744×3000 tile) in an image viewer.
transcription_procedure.step_2: Locate the printed side scale — typically a column of numbers at the left or right edge of each panel.
transcription_procedure.step_3: Record the numeric values and their pixel y-positions on the full-resolution TIFF.
transcription_procedure.step_4: Fit a linear regression: stage_value ~ pixel_y. The slope gives minor_unit_m (stage metres per pixel).
transcription_procedure.step_5: Record the axis zero: the stage value at the bottom crop edge.
transcription_procedure.step_6: Confirm: one minor grid cell = grid_px_y pixels × (minor_unit_m metres/pixel).
transcription_procedure.step_7: Update this file: set stage_unit, minor_unit_m, and change transcription_status to 'complete'.
